name: rlm-worker
title: RLM Worker (generic)
description: Generic child spec for `alineo fork`. No alineo install, no alineo.config.json, no spawnDepth: it can never itself call back into alineo, and Agent.spawn() force-sets its ALINEO_SPAWN_DEPTH to 0 regardless of what's here — a structural guarantee, not a convention.
author: alineo
